structure.layout: Full-height map app: a fixed top bar above a 420px left detail panel (with its own scroll and tabs) and a full-bleed 3D Moon map canvas on the right (captured while loading)

aesthetics.typography: Fraunces Variable (serif) for the wordmark, the place title 'Haworth' and the finding headline. Inter Variable for everything else: UI, body, labels, and the small uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows (CRATER, LATEST FINDING, WIDTH)
aesthetics.typeScale: Serif display title at 33px/600, card headline at 23–26px serif, section heads 16px semibold, body 15px, secondary 13–14px, uppercase eyebrows 11px with tracking, micro labels 9px. Hierarchy comes from mixing serif and sans more than from weight

notes: Space-themed dark UI. Near-black backgrounds in several close shades, with an ice-blue primary (#7cc7ff) and a warm amber accent (#ffc86b) used for distances and the sun. Editorial serif headings (Fraunces) set against Inter body text give it a museum-exhibit feel. The ice-share bar is drawn from many thin vertical ticks rather than a solid fill. In the capture the 3D map region is still in its loading state: a radial dark gradient, a small shaded moon sphere, the text 'Charting the Moon's surface…' and a thin progress bar. Its markers, layer toggle, zoom/3D controls and a play/date/time-slider sunlight timeline are in the DOM but covered. On the live page the map later loaded: a grayscale crater relief map with blue shading for permanently shadowed areas, labelled craters, a dashed outline around the selected crater, and a bottom timeline bar. The search combobox opens a 'Try one of these' suggestion dropdown with a NEW label pill. The Compare tab shows a big serif distance number and a side-by-side attribute table. The URL hash encodes the selected place and tab.
